transcript: Speaker A (Mira): पति की ऑफिस पार्टी में HR ने पूछा... [At my husband's office party, the HR asked...] Speaker B (HR): So what do you do? Speaker A: मैं बोली... I... home... काम... [I said... I... home... work...] HR मुस्कुराई और किसी और से बात करने लग गई। वो साइलेंस जिंदगी की सबसे भारी इंसल्ट थी। [The HR smiled and walked away. That silence was the biggest insult of my life.] (Mira practices English using the English Seekho app at night, learning to introduce herself and her family). 3 महीने बाद दिवाली पार्टी थी। [3 months later, it was the Diwali party.] Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Mira, so good to see you again. How have you been? Speaker A: I have been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur... Speaker E (Boss): Rahul, your wife is very charming. Speaker D (Husband): आज मुझे प्राउड फील हुआ। [Today I felt proud.] Speaker A: इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो, ₹1 का ट्रायल है। [Download the English Seekho app, there is a 1 rupee trial.] Speaker F: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A homemaker feels deeply embarrassed at her husband's office party due to her inability to speak English. She downloads the English Seekho app, practices daily using the AI coach during a 1-rupee trial, and confidently speaks at the next party, earning praise from her husband's boss. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to speak English confidently.
